title: CD Booklet Studies
description: Nine independent 90s CD-booklet studies — each spread tests silver jewel-case reflections, grainy high-contrast photography, distorted stretched letterforms, and photocopied toner speckle at modern capture fidelity.
creative_direction: Each image is a 1:1 booklet spread crop for a different component (front cover, lyrics spread, photo collage, tracklist, credits, inner sleeve art, silver disc, cassette insert, back cover). Shared palette: silver plus crushed blacks plus one faded accent color per spread. Shared treatments: jewel-case reflection, fine photocopy noise, distorted stretched serifs overlapping small-caps columns.
